title: Finite compactification units are invertible
statement:
With the data of [def-sfb-exact-compactification-unit], if the proper part p of c is finite, then δ(c,F,a) is an isomorphism of functors on the entire unbounded derived category.
Conventions and constructions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-sfb-exact-compactification-unit].

proof.text: The map induced by a on homotopy categories is an isomorphism, with inverse induced by a inverse. Finite direct image is exact, so its total-right-derived unit is invertible. Every factor of the transformation before descent is therefore invertible. The fully faithful precomposition functor takes the preimage isomorphism to that transformation, hence the descended transformation is invertible.
